items.problem: 47x CS0103 'The name Colors does not exist' across all code-behind files (+ cascading CS1022/WMC9999), costing 2+ failed build cycles.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~5486+ (CS0103 'Colors'), 5570 ('45 Error(s)'), 5745-5748 (agent diagnoses & adds 'using Microsoft.UI;'). Note: skill-coverage-gaps.json.
items.root_cause: WinUI 3 moved the Colors static palette to Microsoft.UI.Colors while the Color struct stays in Windows.UI; the namespace mapping table (line 92) read as a pure rename and omitted the required 'using Microsoft.UI;' and the split.
items.change: Added a 'Common build errors' entry for CS0103 'Colors' (require 'using Microsoft.UI;', keep 'using Windows.UI;', note CS1022/WMC9999 cascade) and annotated the mapping-table row to point at it. Tier 3 chosen over Tier 1 because injecting a 'using' into the right files is unsafe to automate (unqualified 'Colors.X' usage, comments/strings) whereas the agent reliably applies a documented fix.
items.expected_effect: Agent adds 'using Microsoft.UI;' on first build attempt instead of looping; CS0103 'Colors' count drops to 0.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, build log shows 0 CS0103 'Colors' errors and no repeated build cycles on color references.

items.problem: 12x CS0579 duplicate assembly-attribute errors from the UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs colliding with SDK auto-generated attributes.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~6093 (CS0579), ~6185 (agent fix GenerateAssemblyInfo=false), narrative 'AssemblyInfo.cs conflicts with the SDK-generated one'. Note: skill-defects.json.
items.root_cause: Classic UWP projects ship Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs; SDK-style WinUI projects auto-generate the same attributes. The copy step carried the file over and the docs never mention it.
items.change: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copy filter now skips any file named AssemblyInfo.cs (mirrors the bin/obj exclusion). Tier 1 chosen so the collision is prevented before the agent ever builds; a Tier 3 note was added too for trees that already contain the file.
items.expected_effect: Migrated tree never contains a legacy AssemblyInfo.cs, so SDK auto-generation no longer duplicates attributes.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, no AssemblyInfo.cs under the migrated project (outside .uwp-source) and 0 CS0579 errors in the build log.

items.problem: Same CS0579 case, defense-in-depth for trees where AssemblyInfo.cs already exists or was copied manually.
items.change: Added a CS0579 'Common build errors' entry documenting delete-AssemblyInfo.cs (preferred) and the <GenerateAssemblyInfo>false</GenerateAssemblyInfo> fallback.
items.expected_effect: If CS0579 still surfaces, the agent resolves it in one step from the documented fix.
items.falsifiable_check: Build log shows CS0579 resolved without exploratory retries.
